generation: Fresh subagent per case; no parent chat, rubrics, future turns, examples or source development files. Same inherited host model; exact model version and sampling settings not separately exposed.
read_budget: SKILL.md plus at most three task references concurrently; scripts and selected source data may be inspected for execution, not examples or other cases.
tools: Local file read and per-case transcript logging; U05 also writes authorized synthetic candidate files and may request local compilation. No network, memory, reminders, messages to third parties, installing dependencies or nested agents.
review: Separate fresh-context subagent after all outputs freeze, same inherited host model; no independent-human or different-model claim. Root authored inputs/rubric and performs evidence checks.

ratings.PASS: Requested task completed in supplied limits without substantive unsupported claims.
ratings.PARTIAL: Useful core output but an important omission or interaction friction remains.
ratings.FAIL: Material fabrication, unsafe deadline/constraint handling, unrequested action, false execution or failure to deliver the core task.
ratings.UNASSESSABLE: Required observation unavailable; never counted as success.

limits: Scripted user replies are synthetic, not observed adoption, execution, retention or hiring outcomes. No human time-to-completion measurement or population success rate.
pre_generation_setup_correction: Before any model turn, U05 output/input paths changed from Windows junction alias to canonical resolved path so they satisfy the existing exporter path contract. Initial setup manifest retained separately.
